name: hero-loop
alt: The saywhen pill moves from Waiting to Check as spoken words become cargo test --release. The preview counts down and the command is sent to Terminal.
caption: Look. Talk. Sent.
placement: README header, above the project title

name: five-states
alt: The five saywhen states light up in order: Waiting, Ready, Listening, Writing, and Check. A short line under each state says what the app is waiting for.
caption: See what saywhen is waiting for.

name: cleanup
alt: Two spoken phrases are crossed out as saywhen turns them into cargo test --release and kubectl get pods.
caption: Say the words. Get the command.
placement: How it works, after the stop-talking step

name: send-styles
alt: Four send cards show a countdown, a nod, the words send it, and typing without pressing Enter.
caption: Choose how you want to send.

name: cancel
alt: Pressing Esc stops a preview countdown and shows Canceled. Nothing sent. The visual also shows that shaking your head or talking again can stop the countdown.
caption: Cancel while the preview counts down.
placement: Pick how you send, after the ways to stop a send

name: safety
alt: A warning marks rm -rf dist/ as paste only. The command sits at the terminal prompt with Enter still unpressed.
caption: Risky commands wait for your hand.

name: privacy
alt: An illustrated camera frame produces readings for head angle, lips moving, and face present. The picture fades away and the readings remain.
caption: The picture is never saved. Only the numbers are used.
